```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010.csv')
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]

def qualifies_median(row):
    vals = row[years]
    non_missing = vals.notnull().sum()
    below = (vals < 35).sum()
    return (non_missing >= 9) and (below <= 1) and (vals.median() > 35)

q_med = df[df.apply(qualifies_median, axis=1)]['Country Name']
print(', '.join(sorted(q_med)))
```
